author: parbol
body:
#### PR description:

- This PR adds a new package to the Alignment/ directory to handle alignment constants for the MTD detector. The package is very similar to their muon or tracker counterparts (Alignment/MuonAlignment and Alignment/TrackerAlignment) and defines a hierarchy of mechanical structures (Alignables) that can be shifted or rotated propagating down the changes to their substructures. The package also defines an initial draft of possible misalignment scenarios for the MTD.

- The package doesn't interfere with any workflow of CMS, as it should be run only on purpose whenever a new set of alignment constans or a new alignment scenario is going to be generated. 

- The package has been presented several times in the MTD DPG meetings (adding here two examples):

https://indico.cern.ch/event/1650922/contributions/6940279/attachments/3224408/5746074/DPG-MTD-Alignment.pdf
https://indico.cern.ch/event/1584281/contributions/6676950/attachments/3139268/5571232/DPG-MTD-Alignment.pdf

#### PR validation:

I have run the usual checkdeps and scram b runtests and I have also make sure that scenarios and geometries are correctly dumped into sqlite databases.
